Product names and SDK or API names with a source: Internet & SaaS, Private Access, Zscaler App, Zero Trust Browser, ZBI, ZGuard, ecgroup, deep trace, ZTC
subjects.lead: Current help pages name ZIA Internet & SaaS and ZPA Private Access, for example "Public Service Edges for Internet & SaaS (ZIA)" and "Private Access (ZPA)".

subjects.title: Service Edge names in logs, APIs and support: ZEN, broker, PSEN, VZEN
subjects.lead: In the Private Access user activity log, ConnectorZEN is the Public Service Edge that sent the request from the App Connector.
